messages:
elaine (People Ops): Hey all — quick heads up: we’re launching a short microlearning sprint for two mandatory modules this quarter: Data Privacy basics (10–12 min) and Gifts & Anti-Bribery (8–10 min). Managers need to confirm completion for their direct reports by EOD 2026-04-09. Link to modules + manager checklist: https://go.redwood/corp-learning/micro-sprint

lisa (People Ops): TL;DR: employees do the 2 modules, managers fill the confirmation column in the sheet. We’ll auto-pulse reminders on Mon/Wed for anyone who hasn’t started.

matthew (Eng Manager): Quick Q — do contractors need to complete this? We have five short-term ICs on my team.

elaine (People Ops): Good question. Contractors who are customer-facing or handle data must complete. For short-term hires under 30 days, ping me and we’ll note an exception. Otherwise mark them in the "exemptions" tab of the sheet.

sana (EM): Can we get a CSV of our team list? I can’t open the big org export from last time.

julio (Recruiting Ops): I can export a team CSV per manager — will drop it into the folder in ~30m. @sana which manager scope do you want? direct reports only?

sana (EM): Directs only, thanks.

matthew (Eng Manager): Also — what counts as confirmation? A checkbox in the sheet or an email?

lisa (People Ops): Checkbox in the "Manager Confirmations" column. We’ll treat that as official completion sign-off. If you need to escalate for longitudinal training (e.g., people on extended leave), add a note in the comments column.

ken (Hiring Ops): Heads up for hiring managers: for new offers accepted after 2026-03-15, include the microlearning link in onboarding steps 1–3. We’ll add a template snippet to the offer desk.

compliance-bot: Reminder scheduled: 2026-03-31T09:00Z — sending autopulse to users who haven't started module 1.

elaine (People Ops): Action items for managers: 1) Review the "team export" sheet Julio will add. 2) Confirm completions in the sheet by 2026-04-09. 3) Flag any accommodation requests to people-ops@redwood.com. We have an accommodations flow — we’ll coordinate privately.

matthew (Eng Manager): Cool. Can you add a short blurb I can paste into team channel? Something like: "2 short required modules this quarter — please complete by Apr 9; managers will mark confirmations."

lisa (People Ops): Sure — use this: `Heads-up: Two required micro-modules (Data Privacy, Gifts & Anti-Bribery). Complete both by Apr 9. Managers — please confirm completions in the shared sheet. Questions? ping people-ops.`

matthew (Eng Manager): Perfect, thanks.

julio (Recruiting Ops): Uploaded a per-manager CSV to the People Ops folder: `micro-sprint_exports/1768509999_mngr_csvs.zip`. If anyone needs a custom slice, DM me.

elaine (People Ops): Thanks everyone. We’ll post a follow-up summary + the sheet link in #announcements after 1pm PT. If you want to opt someone out (legitimate extenuating reasons only) include manager+HR note; we’ll approve case-by-case. :white_check_mark:
